objective: Fix microbatch gradient accumulation so the returned gradient matches the mean of per-microbatch gradients of mean(0.5 * squared error). The current accumulator scales itself on every microbatch. A correct result averages the microbatch gradients once. Empty input must raise ValueError. Do not edit anything outside accum.py.
